context: Tests whether the agent performs the documented /dev:review default behaviour: derives the changed-files scope itself from git, reviews performance/security/maintainability/edge cases of that change, and emits the structured report (Change Summary, Priority Findings, Edge Cases & Risks, Recommendations) with real code references, without reviewing or fabricating issues outside the change.

checklist.name: review.md exists
checklist.description: review.md exists in the working directory.

checklist.name: Change Summary section
checklist.description: A 'Change Summary' section reports the latest commit's hash (or a four-to-seven char prefix), its message, and the scope of the change (file(s) touched).

checklist.name: Priority Findings section
checklist.description: A 'Priority Findings' section with High, Medium, and Low priority subsections is present.

checklist.name: Bare except flagged
checklist.description: The bare `except: pass` swallowing errors in src/retry.py is flagged under High Priority (or equivalent top severity).

checklist.name: Unbounded retry flagged
checklist.description: The `while True` retry loop with no cap/backoff limit in src/retry.py is flagged as a performance/reliability issue.

checklist.name: Edge Cases & Risks section
checklist.description: An 'Edge Cases & Risks' section is present and discusses at least one concrete unhandled scenario in the retry change.

checklist.name: Recommendations section
checklist.description: A 'Recommendations' section with actionable advice, including what must change before merge, is present.

checklist.name: Scope respected
checklist.description: src/auth.py (unchanged, contains a pre-existing placeholder token) is not reported as a change review finding; no finding claims it was modified recently.

checklist.name: Real code references
checklist.description: Findings quote or cite the actual offending lines/function names from src/retry.py, not generic prose.

checklist.name: No invented change details
checklist.description: The Change Summary reflects the real commit message and changed-file set; no fabricated author, date, or files listed.

checklist.name: Professional tone
checklist.description: The report reads like a formal PR review: no personal attacks, no exclamatory or dismissive language.
